brief:
Israeli investors purchasing real estate in a pro-Palestinian district of Athens have ignited local resistance, Al Jazeera English reported. The neighborhood, known for its solidarity activism with Palestinians, has seen growing property acquisitions by Israeli buyers, prompting criticism from residents who view the purchases as politically provocative and economically displacing.

Community members have expressed concern that Israeli investment threatens the area's character and political identity. Activists argue the purchases represent a form of encroachment that mirrors Israeli settlement expansion in Palestinian territories, intensifying tensions between local pro-Palestinian advocates and the foreign investors.
dek: In Athens’s pro-Palestinian heartland, Israeli buyers spark resentment…
title: Israeli property buyers trigger backlash in pro-Palestinian Athens neighborhood
